description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Instant Cast 1], [Soul Break Gauge +250], [Damage Cap +10000], [Awoken Imperial General] and [Imperial General Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Imperial General
description.text: Unlimited Knight hones, Knight abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Pursuit Sword after using Knight abilities

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Imperial General Follow-Up
description.text: Casts General Blade after using Knight abilities

description.name: General Blade
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to all front row allies
